context.passage:
NOTICE
Per a new local ordinance, Creekview Road will be closed to motor vehicle transit
between Poplar and Cherry Streets from 6 A.M. to 9 P.M. on Saturdays and Sundays
starting next month. The two-mile stretch of road will remain open to pedestrians
and nonmotorized vehicles. The policy goes into effect on April 4 and will continue
indefinitely.
This ordinance comes from the Fairview local council, headed by Ellis Birmingham,
and represents efforts by the council to promote community wellness. Creekview
Road runs alongside the protected parkland of the Fairview Creek Gorge, which is
known for its impressive views of Grand Valley. The forthcoming change will allow
park visitors, including joggers, cyclists, and hikers, to spread out beyond the park's
trails and safely utilize the full roadway during the weekends.

items.question: What is the purpose of the Creekview Road closure?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：篇章中可定位到“park visitors, including joggers, cyclists, and hikers, to spread out beyond the park's”。选择理由：该项复现或同义改写了定位信息，其他选项与原文细节不一致。正确答案：C（To encourage walking and cycling）。
